title: CuraEngine CLI adapter config
description: Configuration for the CuraEngine headless slicer CLI. Safe probe uses 'help' subcommand only.

exe_path.description: Absolute path to CuraEngine or CuraEngine.exe.

version.description: Detected version string from 'CuraEngine help', e.g. '5.12.1'.

profile_dir.description: Directory holding Cura JSON definition files for headless use.

cli_supported.description: True when CuraEngine supports the 'help' and 'slice' subcommands.

safe_probe_args.description: Arguments used for the read-only version probe. Never include 'slice'.
